summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all six paragraphs of the supplied working Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the dialogue, comparisons, comprehensive negations, causal explanations, vineyard image, concluding imperative and promise, and the difficult assertion that sorrow wears away the Holy Spirit and again saves, without supplying an unstated object or doctrinal condition. Reader-facing “servants” follows current policy; no repentance terminology occurs here. The notes distinguish the selected readings from reported alternatives and identify editorial brackets and reconstruction rather than presenting them as unanimous manuscript text. Acceptance concerns fidelity to the supplied working source and disclosure of the stated alternatives; it does not verify the cited external editions, plates, manuscript hands, or completeness of collation. No replacement wording is proposed or approved.
